label: SYNTHETIC
note: Stylised twin bored tunnel drive invented for this study. It is not a real line, station, building or site. Geometry and buildings are SYNTHETIC; ground parameters are published typical values or ASSUMPTION as labelled.

alignment.diameter_basis: ILLUSTRATIVE: S1 Table 14.1 gives typical K and V for tunnels up to 6.6 m excavated diameter

design.source: S1 Table 14.1, Old Alluvium, pressure balance machine

ground_zones.formation: Mixed face: Old Alluvium with Kallang Formation

design.source: S1 Table 14.1, mixed-face of Kallang and other formation, pressure balance machine

observed_vl.source: S5 Table 2, row 9 (OA mixed with Kallang Formation, EPB TBM)

design.source: S1 Table 14.1, Kallang Formation, pressure balance machine

observed_vl.source: S5 Table 2, row 8 (Kallang Formation, EPB TBM)

existing_tunnel.label: SYNTHETIC
existing_tunnel.description: Invented existing bored rail tunnel crossing above the new drives at right angles
existing_tunnel.allowable_source: S2 Table 2(b): bored tunnel, total movement in any direction 15 mm
existing_tunnel.allowable_differential_source: S2 Table 2(b): bored tunnel, differential movement in any plane 15 mm or 1:1000, whichever is lesser; only the gradient part is checked here

poisson_ratio.label: REAL
poisson_ratio.basis: S3 Eq. 10 is written for Poisson's ratio 0.3

alert_factor.label: ASSUMPTION
alert_factor.basis: Alert level set at 70% of the work suspension level. S1 Cl. 13.7 defines the two levels but gives no ratio.

min_suspension_level_mm.label: ASSUMPTION
min_suspension_level_mm.basis: Floor so that instruments with very small predictions are not triggered by survey scatter

heave_alert_mm.label: ASSUMPTION
heave_alert_mm.basis: S1 Cl. 13.7.6 asks for heave levels; no value is published, 70% of the heave suspension level is used

heave_suspension_mm.label: ASSUMPTION
heave_suspension_mm.basis: No published value; set equal to the minimum settlement suspension level

marker_noise_sd_mm.label: ASSUMPTION
marker_noise_sd_mm.basis: Standard deviation of one settlement-marker reading; S8 Table 3 uses a 1 mm measurement error

vl_distribution.label: ASSUMPTION
vl_distribution.basis: Shape chosen by the author; mean and 95th percentile matched to S5 Table 2. S5 notes that the data do not always follow a normal distribution.

k_distribution.label: ASSUMPTION
k_distribution.basis: Range chosen by the author to bracket the S1 design value and the S5 best-fit value

vl_correlation_between_drives.label: ASSUMPTION
vl_correlation_between_drives.basis: Both drives share one volume-loss draw in the base case; the independent case is reported as a sensitivity

depth_tolerance_m.label: ASSUMPTION
depth_tolerance_m.basis: Range of axis depth used in the sensitivity study

second_tunnel_factor_range.label: ASSUMPTION
second_tunnel_factor_range.basis: S3 section 2.4 says interaction can be allowed for with a greater volume loss for the second tunnel; no factor is given

stabilised_distance_diameters.label: REAL
stabilised_distance_diameters.basis: S7 section 3.1: settlement taken at 5D after the TBM has passed the array
